article.summary_es: La Iglesia St. George's Episcopal en Brooklyn ofrece comidas de cocina comunitaria y despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: St. George's Episcopal Church in Brooklyn offers soup kitchen meals and a food pantry, according to the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Cocina comunitaria: martes a jueves de 12:30pm a 2pm.
Despensa de alimentos: viernes de 10am a 2pm.
Está en 800 Marcy Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11216.
No se indica qué alimentos dan ni si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen: Tuesday to Thursday, 12:30pm to 2pm.
Located at 800 Marcy Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11216.
You can call (718) 789-6036 to ask questions.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements.
